layout: frame-major, then row-major (row 0 = lat +90), per cell: ppm_index (0-255 = 380..460 ppm, 0 also means no cloud), density (0-255 = how thick/bright the CO2 cloud is)
source: NASA SVS 5436 DYAMOND CO2 (volume layer), Jan-Mar 2020, one sample every 30 hours
note: decoded from colours; ppm is approximate (about +/-8 ppm), values below ~415 ppm are only a rough brightness guess
